tagline: One of the largest banks worldwide serving more than 172 million customers
hero_kpi_rationale: Principal credit risk indicator for a consumer finance bank in a challenging economic context. The increase in NPL ratio in 2024 reflects rising defaults in retail and corporate portfolios, signaling major credit pressure requiring close monitoring.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin remains solid thanks to good cost management and steady revenue generation offsetting special effects related to transformation restructurings.

kpis.name: Non-Performing Loan Ratio
kpis.explanation: Proportion of defaulted loans relative to total loans.
kpis.description: NPL ratio increased in 2024 due to rising defaults among individuals and companies, as well as a strategic decision made in mid-2023 to defer impairments by 12 months for economic considerations, extending internal processing and subsequent sale of non-performing loans.
kpis.signal: Increase linked to recession and impairment deferrals

kpis.name: Capital Ratios
kpis.explanation: Financial strength indicators such as CET1 or Tier 1.
kpis.description: Capital ratios remain comfortably elevated, reflecting a resilient position against economic shocks and regulatory requirements from the Single Supervisory Mechanism (SSM) and the German Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (BaFin).
kpis.signal: All ratios well above regulatory thresholds

risks.title: Increase in NPL ratio in retail portfolios
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly detailed in Item 1A (page 30-31). Direct language: 'NPL ratio rises during 2024 in line with the observed increase of delinquencies and defaults'. Trend UP (2.16% to 3.19%). Significant weight: direct impact on provisions (-€288.5M vs -€217.4M) and profitability.

risks.title: Dependence on German economic stability and recessions
risks.score_rationale: Explicit context in Executive Summary (page 4): 'Germany found itself in a recession for the second time in a row'. Language of moderate intensity but structural context. Trend STABLE (cyclical recessions). High weight: 51.1% of portfolio in Mobility (auto-finance sensitive to economic cycles).

risks.title: Intensifying competition and customer loyalty erosion
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified in 2025+ Roadmap (page 18): 'DECLINING LOYALTY' and 'NEW COMPETITORS' listed as market trends. Direct language on defensive objectives ('Defend Leadership'). Trend UP. High category weight: fragmented auto-finance market with 10+ listed major competitors.

risks.title: Bank regulation risk and increased capital requirements
risks.score_rationale: Explicit supervision mentioned (page 8-9): ECB/SSM and BaFin. Capital ratios detailed (CET1 14.94%, Total Capital 16.83%). Neutral language but strict compliance context. Trend STABLE (ratios 'comfortably above regulatory minimum'). Moderate weight: structural constraint but well managed.

risks.title: Dependence on market funding and refinancing
risks.score_rationale: Funding strategy detailed (pages 32-35): 47.7% of funding outside retail deposits (EMTN, Covered Bonds, ABS, Interbank). Positive language ('Diversified funding base') but structural dependence. Trend STABLE (diversification maintained). Moderate weight: market risk in case of liquidity stress.

risks.title: Digital transformation and operational technology risk
risks.score_rationale: 2025+ Roadmap (page 18) identifies 'DIGITALISATION' as key trend with objectives 'Digital Bank with Branches' and 'MySantander as Self-Service Platform'. Language of strategic urgency. Trend UP (transformation in progress). Moderate weight: implementation risk and implicit cybersecurity risk.

risks.title: Auto-finance portfolio concentration and market-specific risk
risks.score_rationale: Mobility portfolio: 51.1% of assets (€18.8 billion). Language of strength ('largest non-captive car finance provider') but high concentration. Trend STABLE (moderate growth +4.9%). High weight: dependence on German automotive industry and mobility trends (electrification, leasing).

risks.title: ESG compliance risk and energy transition
risks.score_rationale: Pages 20-21 detail ESG ambitions and Net Zero 2050. Language of commitment but long-term objectives. Trend UP (initiatives in progress). Moderate weight: growing reputational and regulatory risk on non-green auto/mobility financing.
